tools.name: extract_clean_markdown
tools.description: Converts raw HTML pages into clean, boilerplate-free, LLM-optimized Markdown with preserved hyperlinks and headings. Use when ingesting raw web documents or blog posts into agent context windows; for isolating tabular data into structured datasets, use parse_html_tables instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'html_content' ('conversion_mode' defaults to 'clean_semantic_article'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (10 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

html_content.description: Raw HTML string of the web page or document to convert to clean Markdown.

conversion_mode.description: Markdown extraction strategy: clean semantic article, preserve tables/code, or minimal text.

preserve_links.description: Whether to retain anchor hyperlinks and image markdown references in output.

annotations.title: Web HTML to Clean LLM-Optimized Markdown Engine

tools.name: scrape_readable_article
tools.description: Extracts primary article body, author bylines, publication timestamps, and estimated reading duration from web pages. Use when stripping navigation bars, advertisement containers, and cookie banners to isolate core editorial content; for converting full HTML to markdown, use extract_clean_markdown instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'html_content' ('readability_profile' defaults to 'article_body_strict'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (10 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

html_content.description: Target web page HTML containing the article, editorial post, or blog content.

readability_profile.description: Content isolation heuristic: strict article body, technical documentation, or forum thread.

include_byline.description: Whether to parse author names, affiliations, and editorial publication dates.

tools.name: extract_structured_metadata
tools.description: Extracts OpenGraph tags, Twitter Card metadata, canonical URLs, and Schema.org JSON-LD microdata scripts from HTML. Use when indexing social share cards, author identity, breadcrumbs, and rich snippet schemas for AI search agents; for scanning page hyperlinks and outbound references, use extract_page_hyperlinks instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'html_content' ('metadata_targets' defaults to 'all_protocols'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (10 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

html_content.description: Source HTML string containing head tags, OpenGraph meta properties, or JSON-LD scripts.

metadata_targets.description: Target metadata protocol filter: all protocols, OpenGraph and Twitter, or Schema.org JSON-LD.

include_favicons.description: Whether to extract favicon links and Apple Touch icon references.

annotations.title: OpenGraph, Twitter Cards & JSON-LD Microdata Extractor

tools.name: parse_html_tables
tools.description: Detects and parses HTML table elements into structured JSON record arrays and GitHub-Flavored Markdown tabular grids. Use when converting financial statements, product comparison grids, or sports statistics into structured data tables; for extracting raw clean markdown prose, use extract_clean_markdown instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'html_content' ('output_format' defaults to 'markdown_and_json'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (10 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

html_content.description: Raw HTML string containing one or more table, thead, tbody, or tr elements.

output_format.description: Tabular export formatting standard: markdown and JSON, JSON records only, or CSV string.

min_rows.description: Minimum rows required for a table to be parsed and retained.

annotations.title: HTML Table to Structured JSON & Markdown Parser

tools.name: isolate_css_selectors
tools.description: Evaluates CSS selector queries against HTML DOM trees to extract targeted inner text, outer HTML, or element attributes. Use when targeting specific elements like pricing badges, product titles, review cards, or navigation breadcrumbs; for parsing unstructured contact information, use extract_contact_info instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'html_content' and 'selector_query' ('extraction_mode' defaults to 'inner_text'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (10 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

html_content.description: HTML source markup to query against using CSS selector matching rules.

selector_query.description: CSS selector query expression (e.g., '.pricing-card', '#main h2', 'article p').

extraction_mode.description: DOM extraction representation: text content, outer HTML snippet, or attribute key-value map.

annotations.title: Deterministic Edge DOM CSS Selector Scraper & Isolator

tools.name: detect_paywall_and_bypass
tools.description: Audits web page DOM hierarchies to detect soft paywalls, blur overlays, modal gates, and recovers concealed body text. Use when diagnosing paywall obstructions, diagnosing subscriber gating scripts, or auditing content access barriers; for assessing general SEO hygiene, use evaluate_seo_diagnostics instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'html_content' ('detection_profile' defaults to 'heuristic_dom_overlay'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (15 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

html_content.description: Target web page HTML markup suspected of containing soft paywalls or paywall modals.

detection_profile.description: Paywall detection heuristic: heuristic DOM overlay, hidden text recovery, or strict access barrier audit.

target_domain.description: Optional publishing domain name to look up publisher gating patterns.

annotations.title: DOM Paywall, Modal Gate & Blurred Content Recovery Auditor

tools.name: crawl_sitemap_urls
tools.description: Parses XML sitemaps and sitemap index files into structured URL trees with change frequency and last-modified filters. Use when discovering domain architectures, mapping crawl frontiers, or indexing blog/product catalogues; for extracting on-page hyperlinks from raw HTML, use extract_page_hyperlinks instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'sitemap_xml' ('filter_criteria' defaults to 'all_entries'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (15 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

sitemap_xml.description: XML string of the sitemap or sitemapindex file to inspect and parse.

filter_criteria.description: URL retention filter: all entries, recently modified lastmod only, or HTML pages only.

max_results.description: Maximum number of URLs to extract and return in the catalog.

annotations.title: XML Sitemap & Index Crawler Tree Decompiler

tools.name: extract_page_hyperlinks
tools.description: Extracts, normalizes, and filters internal and external hyperlinks, anchor texts, and downloadable asset targets from HTML. Use when building site crawlers, auditing broken links, or extracting reference citations; for isolating primary readable article narrative text, use scrape_readable_article instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'html_content' ('link_scope' defaults to 'all_links'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (10 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

html_content.description: Source HTML string containing anchor tags, href attributes, and link targets.

link_scope.description: Link extraction scope: all links, internal domain only, external links only, or download assets.

base_url.description: Base URL of the target page for resolving relative link paths.

annotations.title: Web Hyperlink, Anchor & Asset Extraction Filter

tools.name: sanitize_html_content
tools.description: Sanitizes raw HTML by removing malicious script tags, iframes, inline event handlers, and data URIs into safe markup. Use when preparing untrusted third-party web content for rendering in agent dashboards or email clients; for converting clean HTML into markdown, use extract_clean_markdown instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'html_content' ('sanitization_strictness' defaults to 'strip_scripts_and_iframes'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (10 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

html_content.description: Untrusted or potentially hazardous HTML string requiring sanitization.

sanitization_strictness.description: Sanitizer filter policy: strip scripts and iframes, allowlist safe formatting, or plaintext strip all.

preserve_images.description: Whether to retain safe img elements with http/https sources.

annotations.title: Edge HTML Sanitizer, Script Stripper & XSS Neutralizer

tools.name: extract_contact_info
tools.description: Extracts email addresses, telephone numbers, physical addresses, and social network handles from web text and DOM footers. Use when researching sales leads, aggregating business contact directories, or extracting customer service info; for parsing structured tabular data, use parse_html_tables instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'content' ('extraction_focus' defaults to 'all_contacts'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (10 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

content.description: Raw text or HTML page content to scan for contact channels and lead info.

extraction_focus.description: Contact filter focus: all contact info, emails and phones only, or social handles only.

country_hint.description: Two-letter ISO country code for telephone numbering format hints.

annotations.title: Lead Contact, Email, Phone & Social Handle Extractor

tools.name: evaluate_seo_diagnostics
tools.description: Audits HTML heading structures, title lengths, meta descriptions, image alt tags, and OpenGraph compliance into a health score. Use when auditing landing pages, verifying SEO compliance before publishing, or evaluating crawl friendliness; for extracting article bodies, use scrape_readable_article instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'html_content' ('audit_level' defaults to 'comprehensive_audit'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (10 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

html_content.description: Web page HTML string to evaluate against search engine optimization standards.

audit_level.description: Diagnostic audit scope: comprehensive audit, meta tags only, or heading hierarchy only.

target_keyword.description: Primary search keyword to check for in titles, headings, and meta tags.

annotations.title: Web SEO Diagnostics & Heading Hierarchy Auditor

tools.name: compile_rss_feed
tools.description: Transforms JSON item collections or article card arrays into standardized RSS 2.0, Atom 1.0, or JSON Feed 1.1 syndication feeds. Use when syndicating blog articles, product announcements, or changelog cards to RSS readers and AI agents; for compiling structured sitemap listings, use crawl_sitemap_urls instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'items_json' and 'channel_title' ('feed_standard' defaults to 'rss_2_0'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (15 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

items_json.description: JSON string representing an array of article or feed items with title, link, and pubDate.

channel_title.description: Headline title for the syndication feed channel.

feed_standard.description: Target syndication feed specification: RSS 2.0, Atom 1.0, or JSON Feed 1.1.

annotations.title: Web Content to RSS 2.0 & Atom Feed Compiler
